scope.coverage: recent 2-3 weeks with necessary earlier goal context

nodes.title: Natural-language maritime recruitment work entry
nodes.plain_language_description: Let a user describe a crewing need naturally, receive clarification when needed, and obtain a useful result through the real product path.

nodes.title: Trustworthy business state and visible result
nodes.plain_language_description: User language, authoritative business state, retrieval, and the Frontend-visible outcome must not contradict one another.

nodes.title: Recruitment semantic and workflow slices
nodes.plain_language_description: Build bounded semantics, clarification, Work/Context/Position handling, validated mutation, and controlled retrieval around existing business capabilities.

nodes.title: Maritime authority and explicit fallback
nodes.plain_language_description: Separate canonical known vessel scope, explicit ANY, missing, unknown, and explicitly authorized position-only fallback.

nodes.title: Real runtime, Frontend continuity, and responsiveness
nodes.plain_language_description: Use the real provider, HTTP handler, Backend projection, and browser path while measuring latency and preserving semantic continuity.

nodes.title: Architecture mechanism comparison
nodes.plain_language_description: Compare structured semantic calls, authority observations, refinement, budget, and a bounded Agent Loop without assuming the loop is superior.

nodes.title: External DSH failure discovery
nodes.plain_language_description: Generate constrained natural-language sessions against frozen candidates and check observable business invariants outside the product Runtime.

nodes.title: Parsed user facts are not automatically executable filters
nodes.plain_language_description: A fact can be preserved as user evidence without becoming a retrieval predicate unless the business/data contract authorizes it.

nodes.title: Agent Loop may improve multi-act semantic work
nodes.plain_language_description: A bounded loop with authority observations might improve multi-act interpretation and target ownership, but this is an empirical hypothesis.

nodes.title: Lifecycle terminality prevents later mutation
nodes.plain_language_description: A cancelled Work should remain immutable to later mutations, but a cancellation response alone is not evidence that this is true.

nodes.title: Phase 2.1 Treatment package comparison
nodes.plain_language_description: Compare one structured semantic call with a bounded Agent Loop plus read-only maritime authority access on shared downstream behavior.

nodes.title: Phase 2.2 mechanism ablation
nodes.plain_language_description: Isolate authority observations, extra budget, refinement, authority plus refinement, and a bundled Agent Loop reference on unseen target/sentinel cases.

nodes.title: DSH Evaluation and Learning Loop v0
nodes.plain_language_description: Run real frozen-candidate conversations with natural-language scenario generation and deterministic invariant checks.

nodes.title: Use validated semantic state before retrieval
nodes.plain_language_description: Clean business-field mutation passes through a validated Semantic Delta; legacy mutation paths are shadow evidence in the clean bridge.

nodes.title: Use authority refinement as provisional semantic candidate
nodes.plain_language_description: For the tested semantic target families, read-only canonical authority observations plus one explicit proposal refinement are the smallest tested safe mechanism.

nodes.title: Make terminal Work immutability a Workflow invariant
nodes.plain_language_description: A mutation cannot commit to a cancelled Work; subsequent new intent must be handled separately and is not identical to full Lead Continuity.

nodes.title: Keep Human Experience Gate separate from Core Architecture Gate
nodes.plain_language_description: Passing ownership and safety gates does not erase user-facing failures such as missing state explanation or compound vessel normalization.

nodes.title: Known/unknown/ANY vessel safety boundary
nodes.plain_language_description: Known vessel, explicit ANY, missing, and explicit unknown are kept distinct; unauthorized vessel-less retrieval is blocked.

nodes.title: Ownership and current-result gates repaired
nodes.plain_language_description: Fresh confirmation evidence passed current-result-after-modification, correction coverage, cross-Work ownership, and clarification safety for the tested sessions.

nodes.title: Terminal ownership gate passed after repair
nodes.plain_language_description: Fresh Confirmation and Discovery sessions passed terminal Work immutability and terminal-to-new-intent re-owning for the bounded generated trajectories.

nodes.title: Agent Loop automatically superior
nodes.plain_language_description: The evidence did not justify promoting the full bounded Agent Loop as necessary or superior; it bundled several mechanisms and carried higher cost.

nodes.title: Silent position-only fallback from unknown vessel
nodes.plain_language_description: Unknown vessel is not silently converted to ANY or position-only retrieval without explicit authorization.

nodes.title: Passing machine gate means Human Experience PASS
nodes.plain_language_description: Core safety or evaluator passes cannot be used to erase known user-facing gaps.

nodes.title: Full Lead/Task Continuity
nodes.plain_language_description: When a user refers to an old, cancelled, or one of several Works, should the system select, create, or clarify the target Work?

nodes.title: Compound and alternative vessel policy
nodes.plain_language_description: How should compound vessel phrases and alternatives such as bulk or container be normalized and scoped?

nodes.title: Target-aware state explanation
nodes.plain_language_description: How should the assistant explain exactly which condition is unresolved for the Work or Context the user asked about?

nodes.title: Global generalization and production readiness
nodes.plain_language_description: Whether the bounded mechanism and ownership results generalize across providers, domains, corpora, and real users remains unknown.

nodes.title: Bounded recruitment demo with evidence control
nodes.plain_language_description: The current branch has a bounded real path, frozen candidate discipline, node-level evidence, repaired lifecycle ownership, and explicit limitations.

relations.explanation: The original recruitment-workflow goal led to bounded semantic, clarification, mutation, and retrieval slices.
The product goal is user-visible through the real Backend-to-Frontend path, not only through an internal parser.
Trustworthy visible state requires a validated business mutation boundary before retrieval and projection.
The bounded clean workflow converted the earlier mixed mutation path into validated Semantic Delta application with legacy shadow comparison.
Separating user evidence from executable predicates supports explicit vessel-scope and fallback safety.
The vessel semantic state and explicit authorization rules reject silent unknown-to-position-only fallback.
Real provider, HTTP, and browser evidence made the bounded demo path observable and testable.
The Agent Loop hypothesis was tested against a single structured-call control under shared downstream behavior.
The Phase 2.1 gain bundled loop, authority, and budget, so Phase 2.2 was designed to isolate the smallest mechanism.
Authority plus one refinement met the preregistered target and sentinel rule while isolated budget/refinement candidates did not.
The full Agent Loop reference did not establish necessity or superiority after a shallower authority-refinement candidate reproduced the bounded target result.
DSH is the external bounded evaluation workstream used to create natural-language sessions and check invariants.
Discovery reproduced terminal mutation and showed that terminal immutability is distinct from complete Lead Continuity.
The terminal Work mutation failure was assigned to the Workflow ownership boundary and repaired locally.
The terminal ownership guard was followed by fresh Confirmation and Discovery gate evidence that passed the tested invariants.
Human UAT exposed compound and alternative vessel behavior that the bounded core gate did not establish.
Human UAT directly recorded that generic re-query behavior did not explain the unresolved condition to the user.
The control rule explicitly prevents a passing machine gate from being treated as Human Experience PASS.
The provisional semantic candidate is part of the current frozen evidence path, but remains bounded and reopenable.
